personal-introduction:
I am 23 years old, with a B.S. in Computer Engineering. I am a Programmer Analyst at WriteSys Traffic Systems, where I work as a full-stack developer using C#/.NET, TypeScript/Angular, and SQL.

I have always been passionate about technology and naturally curious, eager to learn and explore new innovations and trends. Within that passion, I highlight my affinity for programming, especially with C# and the .NET framework, with experience developing web and desktop applications. For example, I worked on the development of a complete web system for managing inventory, products, employees, and orders. This open-source application, available on GitHub, was built with REST APIs in C#/ASP.NET and SQL Server on the back end, and a responsive front end in TypeScript/React and Bootstrap.

As a hobby, I am also interested in 3D, both 3D art (especially using Blender) and 3D printing; both of which I have experience with.
about-this-website-info:
This personal website is where you can find my info and some of my projects (related to software, hardware and engineering), and see some of the artwork of questionable quality I've created in my spare time. Here you can also find links to my socials and see my contact info. Feel free to check out my work and reach out if you have any questions, opportunities or inquiries, both personal and professional.

The website was built from scratch by me, using Angular v20, TypeScript and Sass (SCSS). For some of the components and theming, I used Angular Material. For internationalization and localization I am using Transloco. The source code of the website is on GitHub. Feel free to make suggestions and contributions, or fork the repository to use as a template, just credit me with the proper attribution.
